about: The observables enabled for detection when tools/ace3/trees/make-trees runs ace3, its Redis cache for observable_detection (run_module.py --detections). tests/e2e/run adds the same to ace-rs's observable_detection list through the detection API before its comparison. make-trees also has ace3 export them to YARA rules (run_module.py --export-detections, PLAN.md 7.16), each with its place here from 1 as its id, and tests/e2e/run gives ace-rs's entries the same ids, since a rule's strings are named by them.
